Overview

For CAP Agencies managing multiple LIVE simultaneously, it is essential to have a clear and streamlined way to monitor all creators' LIVE performances at a glance. The new LIVE Analytics feature with upgraded LIVE Dashboard page on TikTok Shop Partner Center, enables CAP Agencies with an overview of all ongoing and completed livestreams, helping them quickly identify any livestreams or creators that may need support. Navigate to: Partner Center > Analytics > LIVE Analytics

What is LIVE Analytics?

LIVE Analytics is a one-stop hub where CAP Agencies can:

  1. View all sellers and creators' ongoing livestreams and get a high level overview of each LIVE's performances
  2. Filter by LIVE status, Creator type, or LIVE starting time to zoom into specific LIVE's that you'd like to focus on
  3. Quickly identify LIVEs that are in Violation or Need Attention
  4. Access all livestreams and export a custom report ... and more! Read on to find out.

Monitoring Ongoing Livestreams

At Ongoing LIVEs, there are a couple of ways you can fully maximize the available features on this page.

Filter by LIVE status, Creator Name, or Start Time
LIVE Status Creator Name Start Time



1. Filter LIVE Status by:
1. All LIVEs
2. LIVEs in Violation		 2. Filter by Creator Name for Creator's you'd like to analyse 3. Filter LIVE Start Time by:
1. Earliest
2. Latest
3. Lowest to highest affiliate GMV
4. Highest to lowest affiliate GMV
Tip #1:

Hover over the "Violation" tag to understand the reason for violation.		 Tip #2:
Filter by creator to assess the performance of individual creators, making it easier to identify top performers and those who may need support.		 Tip #3:
Filter by 'Latest' to access the latest livestreams and quickly address any emerging issues or negative feedback in real time.

Refresh the list of ongoing LIVEs with just 1 click

Keeping the list updated ensures that agencies can monitor current trends and audience interests, allowing for timely adjustments in strategy.

Customize metrics shown on each LIVE card

Tailoring metrics allows Agencies to focus on the specific objectives of each campaign and analyze metrics that align with your unique strategies to make more informed adjustments and optimizations to future livestreams. Hover over the "?" icon to see the metric definition.

Access the LIVE Dashboard for each LIVE

On the LIVE card, click onto "LIVE dashboard" to deep dive into more details on the specific LIVE performance Click on the User Profile carousel section to access the LIVE viewer analysis.

View customer engagement in real time

On the LIVE card, you'll be able to see the creator's name, read comments and view the pinned product. This allows you to address the topics being discussed in the comments and easily track which product the creator is promoting.

Pin up to 3 livestreams you'd like to focus on
Tip #1:
Pin the top 3 performing livestreams to set a clear benchmark for performance, making it easier to measure success against these standards.		 Tip #2:
Pin livestreams with the Violation label to easily identify livestreams requiring attention.		 Tip #3:
Easily unpin livestreams upon improvement and re-pin another livestream that you'd like to focus on.

Reviewing All Livestreams

Access performance data for all LIVEs

At All LIVEs, you can select or search for a specific creator and view the list of livestreams that the creator has completed. This allows you to strategize with the respective creator by analysing the variance in performances between different LIVE sessions and identify what works well, or what can be improved.

Customize metrics shown for all LIVEs

Customize up to 9 metrics for viewing in the list of Livestreams shown. Hover over the "?" icon to see the metric definition.

Access the LIVE Dashboard for each LIVE

Click onto "LIVE dashboard" at the end of the LIVE list to see more details on the specific LIVE performance. Use the "Performance trends" module to understand deviation patterns of important LIVE trends during and after the LIVEs, and click onto "Product", "Promotion" and "Violation" tabs to find product lists, violation records, and promotion giveaways associated to a LIVE.

Export LIVE Reports

Use the "Export all LIVE data" button to download a list of livestreams and get a report featuring LIVE performances based on the metrics you had customised for viewing.

FAQ

  1. I'm unable to see any LIVE cards on the Ongoing Livestreams page. Why is that?
  • This is likely because you do not have any bound sellers, or there are no ongoing LIVEs happening at the moment.
  1. I'm unable to see any livestreams on the All Livestreams page. Why is that?
  • This is likely because there were no historical livestreams created by sellers or creators.
